input_artifacts: User-approved scope decisions in conversation on 2026-10-10

decisions.summary: All four requested areas are MVP capabilities with separate responsibilities: personal Profile, personal preferences, Auth Security and organization Billing.
Account Settings contains personal preferences; organization settings remain in /app/settings.
Profile is global to the user and includes display name and avatar; credentials belong in Security.
Security covers personal password/email, MFA and session/device review and revocation; account deletion is excluded.
Billing belongs to the active organization; only Owner/Admin may view or manage plan, invoices, payment methods, upgrades, downgrades and cancellation.
Desktop web, mobile web, iOS and Android must provide the same operations with platform-adapted UX.
Language, timezone and notifications sync by user; appearance may adapt per device.
Billing provider comparison is deferred to module-design; no provider is selected.
Module-design must verify Auth provider support for MFA and session/device operations across all platforms.
Detailed lifecycle, persistence, cancellation, entitlements, conflicts/offline behavior and capability ownership are design inputs.

actions: Recorded the user's explicit product decisions in the canonical discovery and delivery ledger.
Declared desktop web, mobile web, iOS and Android as required platforms with shared operation semantics and adapted renderers.
Updated the operation-level evidence matrix; all account operations remain missing on all platforms, and no parity is claimed.
Kept billing provider selection and Auth provider feasibility as explicit module-design work.
Did not create issues, implementation tasks, production code, commits or pull requests.
